notes.title: v1.1 Update Released
notes.content:
Due to some great feedback from players of the 1.0 release version I've overhauled the health system. Now you start the game with 3 lives. Enemies drop health packs which you can pick up to boost your health. Every 10 waves or so they will also drop an extra life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185879/53ab2ed1ee9b7e51baa834a1fde9aeac00e7d54c.png[/img]
